formats.key: mintAllowedTokenHolder(address nftContract,address feeRecipient,address minterIfNotPayer,(address allowedNftToken,uint256[] allowedNftTokenIds) mintParams)
effects: The signer pays msg.value in ETH. It must equal the number of token IDs times the drop stage mint price from storage, or the call reverts (_checkCorrectPayment).
The payment goes to the creator payout address from storage, minus a feeBps cut (from storage) sent to feeRecipient from calldata (_splitPayout).
One NFT of nftContract is minted to minterIfNotPayer (or to the signer when it is zero) for each token ID listed (_mintAndPay -> mintSeaDrop).
Each listed token ID of allowedNftToken, which the minter must own, is marked as redeemed for this drop and cannot be used again. The held NFT is not moved.
formats.shown: "Mint as NFT holder" / "Mint to {recipient} for {ETH value}", with the collection, total price, recipient, the gating collection and each token ID being redeemed.

findings.title: mintAllowedTokenHolder: fee recipient that gets part of the ETH payment is hidden.
findings.evidence: SeaDrop.sol _splitPayout: SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH(feeRecipient, feeAmount); descriptor field feeRecipient 'The fee recipient' visible: never. The fee rate is in storage (dropStage.feeBps). The signer pays the shown total either way, and what the signer receives does not change.
findings.fix: Optionally show feeRecipient as an addressName 'Marketplace fee to' field.

findings.title: mintAllowedTokenHolder: the intent sentence does not state how many NFTs are minted.
findings.evidence: mintQuantity = mintParams.allowedNftTokenIds.length; interpolatedIntent 'Mint to {minterIfNotPayer} for {@.value}'. The count is the array length, which no path can interpolate. Each token ID is listed as 'Redeems Token ID'.
findings.fix: None possible today. The token ID list already implies one mint per ID.

cases.notes: Synthetic case, nothing was mined. From the code: 0 ETH is paid, 2 NFTs of 0x5e09… go to the signer, and BAYC IDs 1234 and 5678 are marked redeemed. All three are shown.

formats.key: mintSigned(address nftContract,address feeRecipient,address minterIfNotPayer,uint256 quantity,(uint256 mintPrice,uint256 maxTotalMintableByWallet,uint256 startTime,uint256 endTime,uint256 dropStageIndex,uint256 maxTokenSupplyForStage,uint256 feeBps,bool restrictFeeRecipients) mintParams,uint256 salt,bytes signature)
effects: The signer pays msg.value in ETH. It must equal quantity times mintParams.mintPrice, or the call reverts.
The payment goes to the creator payout address from storage, minus a feeBps cut sent to feeRecipient, which must be on the allowed list.
quantity NFTs of nftContract are minted to minterIfNotPayer (or to the signer when it is zero).
The server signature digest is marked as used, so this signed mint cannot be replayed.
formats.shown: "Mint NFTs" / "Mint {quantity} to {recipient} for {ETH value}", with the quantity, collection, total price and recipient.

findings.title: mintSigned: fee recipient that gets part of the ETH payment is hidden.
findings.evidence: SeaDrop.sol mintSigned -> _mintAndPay -> _splitPayout sends the feeBps cut to feeRecipient. Descriptor has feeRecipient and mintParams.feeBps visible: never. Signed mints must restrict fee recipients (_validateSignerAndParams), and the signer pays exactly the shown total.
findings.fix: Optionally show feeRecipient as an addressName field.
